d: The book "Digital Drawing with Lera Kiryakova. Procreate, 2D Render: From Simple Objects and Characters to Background-Driven Illustrations" is an exhaustive guide to digital drawing by a renowned illustrator and teacher. The primary goal of the book is to help artists master the Procreate software and learn how to create digital illustrations from scratch. The author, Lera Kiryakova, shares professional tips, including the intricacies of working with layers
